svg.title: SignDuplex first segment submission time on continuous input
svg.desc: Final paper Table 4, continuous multi-sentence input. All strategies use the same Uni-Sign translation model. Mean first submission times in seconds: Offline 15.11, SL segmentation 6.48, Online CSLR/SLT 6.26, SignDuplex 5.99, ideal boundary reference 5.91. Lower is better. Time runs from first video frame until the first valid segment is submitted to the translator. SignDuplex reduces this time by 60.4 percent relative to Offline. The reference uses ground-truth sentence boundaries. Bar axes start at zero.
